name: decouple-fleet-refresh-command
title: Decouple sd:fleet-refresh command from installed-skill resolution
description: Make the sd:fleet-refresh command self-contained so it no longer requires resolving the source-only sd-fleet-refresh skill via the installed-skill resolver (Skill(sd-fleet-refresh) fails everywhere because source-only skills are never materialized in .claude/skills/). Change command steps 1-3 to read the procedure directly from the checkout file .agents/skills/sd-fleet-refresh/SKILL.md (with docs/FLEET_ROLLOUT.md as authority) after the checkout-trust gate, instead of skill-by-name resolution. Preserve the checkout-trust safety rails, the source-only status of the skill body, and the mandatory final-report format.
creator: sdelmas
